title: Lively Mustardy Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and spicy one-pot dish featuring lamb, mustard, and Tunisian spices, all wrapped in a pandan leaf for added aroma, this recipe combines the bold flavors of Cajun and Tunisian cuisine, with the added crunch of a shattering crust, making it a high-protein-friendly meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb, cajun spice, mustard, olive oil, onion, and garlic until the lamb is well coated.
Add the chopped apricots and chicken broth to the bowl and mix until everything is well combined.
Lay a pandan leaf flat on a work surface and place about 1/4 of the lamb mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a tight package, and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Place the packages in a large Dutch oven or heavy pot with a tight-fitting lid.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the crust is shattering.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
